title: Part 7: Reflection & Credits
author: J.W.
excerpt: Sixteen days since the first commit. Sixteen days ago, THE S33K3R TRANSMISSION was just an idea scribbled in a notebook. Now it's a living EARTIX with multiple layers, interactive gameplay, cinematic sequences, and mythology that spans collapsed timelines. This has been one of the most creatively fulfilling projects I've worked on—not because of the tech stack, but because of the freedom. This EARTIX doesn't fit into a category. That ambiguity is liberating.
